newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange edges up in better volume.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange edges up in better volume.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange edged higher on Friday, and saw improved activity after lifeless trading earlier in the week.
The All-Share index rose 0.96 point to 385.42 points, up from 384.46 points on Wednesday.

Consumer products manufacturer Paterson Zochonis led the way, up 20 cedis to 240 cedis. Accra Brewery Limited was up five cedis to 620 cedis, Mechanical LLoyd Company up five cedis to 85 cedis, Pioneer Tobacco Company up five cedis to 255 cedis and Unilever was also up five cedis to 875 cedis.
The total turnover rose to 40,820 shares from 20,050 at the previous session on Wednesday.
Bids were well ahead of offers at 3,700,650 to 288,620.
